# Plantae World

> Plantae World is a Mumbai botanical design studio creating landscape architecture, living walls, botanical art, water and lighting systems, and long-term horticultural care for private, hospitality, and commercial environments across India.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://plantaeworld.com/): Studio overview and botanical architecture approach.
- [Services](https://plantaeworld.com/services.html): Landscape architecture, living systems, water, irrigation, lighting, and botanical stewardship.
- [Portfolio](https://plantaeworld.com/selected-works.html): Selected projects including the Malabar Hill Penthouse.
- [About](https://plantaeworld.com/about.html): Studio heritage and owner-led design practice.
- [Contact](https://plantaeworld.com/contact.html): Studio address, email, phone, and project enquiry form.
